title: Simplified Kundalini Yoga (SKY)
introductionDescription: A systematic training of mind to bring about tranquility, increased sense of awareness, clarity and strengthening of mind.
agnaMeditationDescription: Normally the life energy is functioning at 'Mooladhar Chakra', the physical centre of our body, located at the lower end of our spinal column. A trained master initiates the student into meditation practice by changing the working centre to 'Agna Chakra', the mid-point between the eye brows.
shanthiYogaDescription: Shanthi Yoga is taught to balance the excessive flow of energy in the head. It's very important for physical well-being. One should observe the life-force at Mooladhara and practice 'Aswani Mudhra'.
thuriyaMeditationDescription: After one month, the aspirant is taught Thuriya Yoga. The Kundalini Shakthi is lifted from Agna Chakra to Thuriya (also called Sahasradara) the crown of the head, giving a very pleasant sensation.
thuriatheethaYogaDescription: By the thought-force of the Master, the aspirant is taken to the Thuriatheetha State. Here the soul merges into the Absolute State, the Almighty. This is a psychic practice to attain 'Samadhi' and leads to God-Realisation.
whenToMeditateDescription: There is no particular time and specific direction for doing meditation. It can be practiced daily at any time and direction. The mind should be trained to merge with its source daily, so as to purify the soul.
conclusionDescription: This Kundalini Yoga has been systematized and simplified to suit the modern person. It leads to peace of mind, intellectual sharpness, and duty consciousness. When we realize the greatness of our own Self, we reach the highest peak of consciousness, enabling us to respect others' needs and ambitions.
conclusionQuote: "Happiness is never perfect unless it is shared". Let us all share this everlasting happiness with one another and may all of us enjoy the Eternal Bliss.
quotes: Blessing is not possible unless the mind attains very subtle frequencies,when it is strong, lucid and calm
